what: Capacity needed so riders fit in 95% of station-hours (entries + exits, 5am to midnight, 2025), from trees trained on a 95th-percentile loss versus the average forecast plus one flat margin. Both are tuned on 2024 only.
verdict: Trained on the cost of running short, the model covers riders in 96% of 2025 station-hours with 8.3% less capacity than a flat safety margin on the average forecast.
